text_block_list.text:
On the way back from our outing,
Hishi Amazon suddenly stopped in front of a certain signboard.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"Oh!? A family restaurant serving American-style BBQ,
is it? Takes me back."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
That was back when I was still living in America!
My dad used to make food like this for me all the time.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that was back
when I was just a kid...
(ROAAAR, crackle crackle...!)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: We'd start a fire smack dab in the middle of nature and have a wild family barbecue!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: My dad, who loved to cook, would grill these huge chunks of meat, and I'd dig right in like a wild beast!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Growing up watching my old man like that,
I ended up picking up cooking completely myself.
choice_data_list: You got your cooking skills from your dad, huh?
You got your cooking skills from your dad, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Heh, you bet! He's a great old man who still teaches me recipes to this day. A little timid, though.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Still, even with my old man being how he was, there was one thing he stubbornly refused to teach me.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Whenever I ask, "What's the most important thing in cooking?"
that's always the answer I get.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"You have to figure that out for yourself."
...is what they said!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Right? It's just like homework.
I still don't get it at all!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"I try to think through my cooking sometimes,
but I just can't make head or tail of it..."
choice_data_list: I'll help you search for that answer, too.
I'll help you search for that answer, too.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: "Trainy...! Yeah? Well, thanks!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Well then, pop quiz time. If I asked you,
"What's the most important thing in cooking?", what would you say, Trainy?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I see. I think that's super important too!
After all, firepower is the lifeblood of cooking!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Alright! Let's go buy a high-powered stove
for the dorms right now!

Led by an enthusiastic Hishi Amazon,
we headed to the shopping mall to go shopping.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Huh. They sure have all kinds of stoves here,
from household to commercial ones.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
For something unusual, even a charcoal brazier.
Got any recommendations, Trainy?

Seeing how she seemed focused on firepower earlier,
I suggested a large burner, promising to watch over her as her guardian.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
...Whoa there, Trainy.
I mean, sure, that's definitely the strongest firepower, but...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Isn't it hard to make fine adjustments?
I need you to place just as much focus on the heat level.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Mm? You look awfully surprised.
Did I say something strange?
choice_data_list: I thought for sure you were focusing on firepower...

text_block_list.name: Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Customer, are you looking for both high heat and precise temperature control?
If so, I highly recommend this stove!

text_block_list.name: Clerk
text_block_list.text:
High heat for a crisp finish, plus temperature control!
Only one left in stock, so get it while you can!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Wh... Whaaaat!?
That's exactly what I've been looking for!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOH, out of the way, out of the way!!!
That last point is mine, and I'm not handing it over to anyone!!

At first glance, she's wild and boisterous, yet Hishi Amazon possesses a delicate side as well.
That might just be the secret behind her exceptional cooking skills... or so it seems.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I see! "Choosing lively, fresh ingredients"
really is important, isn't it!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Alright! Big Sis Hishiama's gonna show you
how to pick out ingredients straight from the wild!
choice_data_list: Completely feral... I feel like we're headed in the wrong direction...

text_block_list.text:
Led by an enthusiastic Hishi Amazon,
the place we headed to was—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Now then, first up is the fishmonger in this shopping street.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Look at all those lively fish
swimming in the tank!

Just as I was worrying she might grab a live fish
with her bare hands—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: "Still, this is the one I'd choose. Properly prepared and displayed in-season fish."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"And also, I'll take that unwashed burdock root
lined up over at the greengrocer's."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
What are you talking about? This is just the very,
very basics of picking ingredients, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
If you think being wild just means thrashing around, you're dead wrong!
Wildness in the city is a whole different beast!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: My old man might've looked like he was just grilling with raw power, but he actually knew a lot about aging meat.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's stock up big time!
Baskets are a hassle. I'll just take the whole bucket!

Though she was shopping at a whirlwind pace,
Hishi Amazon made sure to keep all the essentials of ingredient selection in mind.
